svg.title: Netflix artwork personalization: SFT and DPO study diagram
svg.desc: A sketch style pipeline inspired by the user's handwritten reference. Input captions feed SFT with teacher-generated explanations. An optional DPO continuation uses a preferred artwork and a randomly sampled alternative. Evaluation is offline.

g.aria-label: One title. Many visual stories. Which artwork fits this viewer?
* Dashed path = one tested continuation; SFT and reasoning-SFT are also evaluated on their own.
Same candidate set in the prompt
No image pixels in the text-only recommender
Context x + known preferred artwork -> teacher
Teacher explanation + correct caption = target y
Reasoning is generated supervision, not a user statement.
Token cross-entropy on the target response
Standard implementation: mask prompt tokens from loss.
Rejected: random alternative from the candidate set
Rejected does not guarantee an observed user skip.
DPO: policy vs. a fixed reference
Same prompt x; compare chosen / rejected responses
Train policy LoRA; keep reference fixed
Reasoning for rejected responses is not established here.
Prompt -> generated caption -> match to a candidate -> show artwork
Reasoning-SFT adds an explanation before the prediction.
Offline IPS gain is not online CTR lift.
Blue = supervised target Green = preference pair Peach = prediction / evaluation
Original study diagram | arXiv:2601.02764v1, sections 4-5 | See README for corrections and implementation assumptions.
